% Pattern: alias/argument. A command opens a theorem with its argument and then
% switches the font, as \renewcommand{\th}[1]{\begin{thm}{#1} \sl}, and closes
% it with \eth. Seen in 2610.17317.
% want thm-1 statement/theorem 1
\documentclass{amsart}
\newtheorem{Thm}{Theorem}
\newenvironment{thm}[1]{\begin{Thm}\label{T:#1}}{\end{Thm}}
\renewcommand{\th}[1]{\begin{thm}{#1} \sl }
\renewcommand{\eth}{\end{thm} }
\begin{document}
\th{main} Every finite space is compact. \eth
\end{document}
